locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Los Angeles International Airport
locations.description: Arrive at LAX; clear customs and baggage (~1 hr); rideshare to Hollywood hotel (~30 min)

locations.name: 🏨 Hollywood Hotel
locations.description: Check in; drop bags; rest briefly. Recommended: Loews Hollywood Hotel (★★★★, 0.3 mi from Walk of Fame) · The Hollywood Roosevelt (historic landmark) · Holiday Inn Express Hollywood Walk of Fame (budget-friendly)

locations.name: 🍽️ Late Dinner – Hollywood Blvd / Sunset Strip
locations.description: Many restaurants open past 9 PM on Hollywood Blvd and the Sunset Strip; enjoy your first LA meal

days.title: ZIPANGU Festival at the Rose Bowl

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel – Leisurely Morning
locations.description: Leisurely breakfast near the hotel; rest up and charge up for the big night ahead

locations.name: 🎵 ZIPANGU Festival – Brookside at the Rose Bowl
locations.description: First major Japanese music festival on US soil! Lineup: Ado ★ Headliner (~1 hr closing set inside the iconic Ado Box) · ATARASHII GAKKO! · MAN WITH A MISSION · CHANMINA · HANA · 10-FEET · Yuki Chiba. Doors: 3:30 PM · First acts: ~4:00 PM · Ado closes: ~10:00 PM. Capacity ~35,000. Organizer: Cloud Nine × Goldenvoice (Coachella organizers). Getting there: Uber/Lyft ~30 min from Hollywood. Official Site

locations.name: 🚗 Rideshare Back to Hotel
locations.description: Uber/Lyft from Rose Bowl back to Hollywood (~30 min). Tip: wait 20–30 min after the show ends for surge prices to drop before booking

locations.name: 🌅 Hotel Breakfast
locations.description: Leisurely breakfast near the hotel; last morning in Hollywood

locations.name: ⭐ Hollywood Walk of Fame
locations.description: Stroll Hollywood Blvd and spot celebrity stars embedded in the sidewalk. Early morning means fewer crowds and great photos — golden hour light is a bonus.

locations.name: 🎬 TCL Chinese Theatre
locations.description: Iconic Hollywood landmark — see celebrity handprints and footprints cast in concrete in the forecourt. Free to browse outside; open from 8 AM. More info

locations.name: 🔭 Griffith Observatory
locations.description: Short 15-min drive up the hill; free admission; sweeping panoramic LA views with the Hollywood Sign in the backdrop. Open from 10 AM — go right at opening to beat the midday crowds. Official Site

locations.name: 🍔 Lunch near Hotel
locations.description: Last meal in LA; many options on Hollywood Blvd and surrounding streets

locations.name: ✈️ LAX – Departure to Toronto (YYZ)
locations.description: Rideshare to LAX at 1:30 PM (~35 min); arrive by 2:30 PM — 2 hrs before international departure. Flight departs ~4:30 PM to Toronto (YYZ). Don't forget to check in online the night before.
